metadata.title: Flexibility of Laplace-Beltrami eigenfunctions under metric variation
metadata.abstract: We study the surjectivity of the differential of the Laplace-Beltrami operator with respect to the metric parameter. We use the obtained results to prove that every small deformation of a nonconstant eigenfunction can be realized with a small perturbation of the metric. As a consequence, we prove that every generic property of smooth functions which is invariant under multiplication by a nonzero scalar is generic for eigenfunctions of the Laplace-Beltrami operator, extending a result by Uhlenbeck.

analysis.progressType: 度量变化下特征函数的局部柔性
analysis.workSummary: 通过分析Laplace–Beltrami算子对度量参数微分的满射性，证明非恒定特征函数的任意小变形可由度量小扰动实现。由此把对非零标量乘法不变的光滑函数generic性质推广成Laplace特征函数的generic性质，扩展Uhlenbeck结果。
techniques: 微分满射与小扰动实现
analysis.breakthrough: 给出特征函数形状受度量调节的广泛局部自由度。
analysis.limitations: generic性质及“小”的函数空间拓扑、特征函数规范化需正文确定；不适用于恒定特征函数，也不表示固定度量下每个特征函数可任意改变。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 谱几何变分及一般性结果，核心相关度高。
